item.title: Monal v6.4.21
item.description:
Monal 6.4.21 | Monal
- Show last usage timestamp of OMEMO keys - Use the iOS 18 UI in the share sheet - Allow using any language in the Display Name field in account settings - Try to improve location sharing accuracy - Improve contact last activity timestamps - Fix several bugs
